system.description: • Effect: Once per day, mark a creature as prey as part of your action — for the rest of the encounter, the Ranger's Combat Marauder bonus applies against it in full, regardless of creature type, and the Ranger gains advantage on all checks made to track, corner, or finish it.

activities.name: Apex Predator
activities.text: Mark a creature as prey: Combat Marauder applies in full and you have Advantage on checks to track, corner or finish it.
